caption:
Let the past stay in the past 

#wellness #wellnessjourney #mindfulness
transcript: Let the past stay in the past, not because it didn't matter, but because it already did its job. No one in this world can change what has already happened. But everyone can change what they do with the moment they have right now. We hold on to the past as if it's still alive, as if thinking about it one more time will somehow rewrite it. But the past isn't a collection of doors you can reopen. It's a story already written, the mistakes, the heartbreaks, the words left unsaid. They live there, not here. And the longer you carry them, the heavier they become, a weight on the soul you were never meant to hold. There comes a moment when you realize what happened doesn't define you. It taught you what ended isn't missing, it made space. And what you cannot change should not keep changing you, because the moment you stop fighting what has already happened, the heart softens, the breath deepens, and the future stops feeling frightening. It becomes open. So let the past rest in the only place it belongs, behind you. And meet yourself in the only place your power has ever existed, here, now. If this speaks to you, send it to someone you care about, someone who might need this today.
